events.title: Celebrate the Holidays at IKEA!
events.desc: Join us on Saturday, November 28th for a festive day of holiday fun and family-friendly activities. Enjoy holiday cookie decorating, create handmade holiday cards, personalize a picture frame to bring home, and discover helpful pantry organizing tips for the season ahead. Whether you're creating new traditions, making memories with loved ones, or looking for holiday inspiration, there's something for everyone to enjoy. events.title: Holiday Card-Making!
events.desc: IKEA Family signup required. Let your creativity shine at our Holiday Card-Making Activity! Using colorful MÅLA arts and crafts supplies, you can design and personalize your own holiday cards to share with family and friends. events.title: Oakland - Holiday Tree Lighting Ceremony
events.venue: Jack London Square, 70 Washington St., Oakland
events.desc: Jack London Squares invites the community to attend the center’s spectacular tree lighting. The event will include the lighting of the tree facilitated by Santa Claus himself. Enjoy laser shoes, faux snow, selfies with Frosty, Santa, and a Christmas Teddy Bear.

events.title: Gnome in the Home Scavenger Hunt
events.desc: Gunnar the gnome has escaped from the holiday shop and made himself at home throughout the IKEA Emeryville showroom! Follow the Showroom path to see where he's hiding and get ready for a picture-perfect surprise in the Swedish Restaurant!

events.title: Holiday Toy Drive at IKEA Emeryville
events.desc: Join us in bringing a little extra joy to local children and families this holiday season. Now through December 10, when you visit IKEA Emeryville, you can purchase a children's toy, small or medium soft toy, game, or craft supply and donate it to a child in our community. Simply place your new, unwrapped donation in the collection bin located just beyond the checkout registers. All donations will support local families through our partnership with UCSF Benioff Children's Hospital, helping make the holidays a little brighter for children in need. Together, we can create a joyful holiday season

events.title: Holiday Circle of Lights
events.source: Mountain View Cemetery · organizer and Bay Area Parent
events.desc: Free outdoor holiday light display daily December 1–January 1, 5–9pm, starting at the front fountain. Features whimsical scenes, illuminated trees and buildings. The organizer explicitly says there is no charge; Bay Area Parent independently confirms the current season, hours and address. Numeric age bounds and registration availability are not published.
